etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: Uncertain; perhaps a variant form of balk, or a corruption of the Danish/German billig "Cheap".
senses: (cribbage) The spoiling of someone's score in the crib.
(transitive) To spoil the score of (someone) in cribbage.
(transitive) To do someone out of their due; to deceive or defraud, to cheat (someone).
